The '''1980–81 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 45th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 7 September 1980 and ended on 14 June 1981. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their second consecutive and 22nd Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
